messages:
anna_sales: Quick thread — FinCore (large EU bank) wants a POC proving EU-only network paths, BYO-HSM keys, and an exportable subprocessor + cert bundle for audit. They want a 3-week trial and a priced SLA add-on for '99.5% success at 200ms P95' in eu-west. Who can scope? cc @ben_presales @carmen_infra @dan_security

ben_presales: I'll lead the quote/SOW. Need: sustained qps, model sizes, embedding intensity, and whether dedicated tenancy required. I'll draft Option A/B/C (routing-only, routing+BYO-KMS, routing+BYO-KMS+dedicated).

anna_sales: They said 120 qps steady, spikes to 250 for ~30m, chat+embeds, Llama-2-70B variant, avg response ~140 tokens. They require HSM-backed BYO keys and rotation proof.

carmen_infra: We support tenant-level region pin and private-link endpoints in eu-west-1 and eu-central-1. BYO-HSM path requires customer-managed VPC peering/private-link; ops must enable. Embedding fallback currently routes to GCP europe-west2 for some quant variants; we can disable per-tenant but embeddings latency/recall may regress.

dan_security: I'll assemble subprocessor list + cert chains. BYO-HSM attestation: we only receive opaque key handles, keys never leave HSM. I'll include rotation logs export and compliance notes.

elaine_ops: I can bundle cert chains, ASN/IP ranges, private endpoint DNS entries, and a runbook (activation, smoke tests, rollback). Will upload to secure share and provide access tokens — ETA tomorrow noon.

ben_presales: Pricing notes: routing-only POC = no infra uplift but needs reserved burst buffer; routing+BYO-HSM = +12% infra uplift for private-link/integration; routing+BYO-HSM+dedicated GPU pool = +35% uplift and min 3-month commit. SLA add-on (99.5%/200ms P95 single AZ) = +22% on top. Will finalize numbers after infra confirms capacity.

anna_sales: Please itemize A/B/C line items for procurement. FinCore legal wants granular breakout.

carmen_infra: Capacity: we can provide a 3-week reserved pool in eu-west-1 assuming 2x headroom for spikes. Need pre-warm for KV caches and pre-load prefixes. Also need to provision dedicated network ACL for their private-link. Example tenant-policy (ops): { "tenant_policy": { "region_pin": ["eu-west-1"], "allow_fallback": false, "private_endpoint": true, "byo_kms": true } } — note allow_fallback=false disables GCP embedding variants.

dan_security: Important: disabling GCP fallback caused embedding recall drop ~1.8% and P95 latency +40ms in our small eval. Must get client sign-off via a quality-vs-residency checkbox in SOW.

contracts-bot: contracts-bot: Request CNT-88421 created for "FinCore BYO-HSM DPA addendum" assigned to @anna_sales and @lisa_legal. Deadline 7 business days.

anna_sales: Two asks before I call them: 1) artifact bundle ETA (ops), 2) priced options A/B/C with assumptions and line items (ben). Also need an ops-ready checklist for client's infra team if private-link required.

elaine_ops: I'll post secure S3 link + one-page customer network ops checklist by EOD.

ben_presales: I'll produce a 1-page quote with itemized uplifts and SOW for the 3-week POC by tomorrow 10:00 UTC. Will flag tradeoffs (cost vs fallback quality).

anna_sales: Scheduling a FinCore infra+legal walkthrough on Thursday. Also call out that multi-AZ hard SLA requires active replication which moves to Dedicated and >=3 month commit.

carmen_infra: Ack. Noting multi-AZ SLA = Dedicated model, different commit/window.

anna_sales: Thanks team ❤️
